hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.py ]]; then ruff format "$f" && ruff check --fix "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css)$ ]]; then npx prettier --write "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.go ]]; then goimports -w "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$(basename "$f")" == Dockerfile* ]]; then hadolint "$f" 2>&1 | head -5 | jq -Rs '{"systemMessage": .}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == */.github/workflows/*.yml || "$f" == */.github/workflows/*.yaml ]]; then actionlint "$f" 2>&1 | head -5 | jq -Rs '{"systemMessage": .}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ About to compact. Consider saving important context (decisions, blockers, next steps) to memory or claude-mem before proceeding."}'
